document: The reviewed notes of the marathon race directory for this release (docs/RACES.md): the evidence files the family binds, race flags the registry’s rule does not give (`flags`) or gives wrongly (`clears`), each with its evidence, the lead’s rulings that allow a flagged race a page (`page_rulings`), the search aliases (`aliases`: a word as the release writes it and its common English name), the rulings on the pairs of the duplicate-edition audit (`duplicate_editions`), the editions those rulings set aside in a form another builder reads (`set_aside_editions`: label, year, the edition kept, the reason; the runner-lookup builder skips their rows), the reviewed notes on editions of listed pairs (`edition_notes`) and the lead’s general rulings (`rulings`). analysis/build_races.py reads it and scripts/verify-races.cjs checks it; the race registry is frozen and holds none of this.

editions: 45th GMAA Green Mtn. Marathon & Half Marathon
duplicate_editions.note: Listed by the near rule: every name of the smaller list is in the other and nearly all finish within one two-minute window of each other.
set_aside: 45th GMAA Green Mtn. Marathon & Half Marathon
duplicate_editions.words: Green Mtn. 2015 and Champlain Islands 2015: set aside the Green Mtn 2015 edition; Champlain Islands 2015 stays in its series (one race of one day under two keys, same race day and winning time in the producer’s notes).

duplicate_editions.note: Listed by the time-only rule: the two lists share several times more finish seconds than chance gives, almost all between 5:00 and 6:30, under different names. Not one list twice.
duplicate_editions.words: Maraton Saltillo La Moderna 2023 and 2024: keep both, with the note `repeated_finish_times` (their finish times past about 5:00 are shared between rows and years; not individual times). No mark on the page beyond their tier; they are unverified and give no number anyway.

duplicate_editions.note: Listed by the near rule: the same names in both years, every finish shifted by the same amount. The data cannot say which year is the real one: 2012 is kept by convention (the earlier year), not because the data show it.
duplicate_editions.words: Maratona SDAM 2012 and 2013: set aside 2013. One list under two years of one race (631 names in both, every finish exactly 150 s apart). The data cannot say which year is real; the earlier one is kept by convention and the entry says so. Both editions carry the note `one_list_two_years` in the notes file.

rulings.about: an edition set aside as a copy
rulings.words: A set-aside edition: listed in the directory’s data with the mark `copy` and the edition it copies, no number, counted toward no total, floor or reading, as you built it; on a page it is not shown as an edition of the race. Put the set-aside list in the notes file in a form another builder can read (`set_aside_editions`: label, year, the edition kept, the reason): the runner-lookup builder will skip those editions’ rows, so one run is not shown as two results; say in your contract that it does.
